description: This file defines the PodLockManager class, which manages acquiring and releasing Redis-based locks for cron jobs to ensure only one pod runs a job at a time. It includes methods for lock acquisition, release, and event emission.

classes.name: PodLockManager
classes.description: Manages Redis-based locks for cron jobs, ensuring exclusive execution by a single pod at a time.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes PodLockManager with a unique pod ID and optional RedisCache.

methods.name: get_redis_lock_key
methods.description: Generates Redis lock key for a given cronjob ID.

methods.name: acquire_lock
methods.description: Attempts to acquire a Redis lock for a specific cron job asynchronously.

methods.name: release_lock
methods.description: Releases the Redis lock if held by the current pod.

methods.name: _emit_acquired_lock_event
methods.description: Emits an event indicating a lock has been acquired.

methods.name: _emit_released_lock_event
methods.description: Emits an event indicating a lock has been released.
